title: Elucidating Mechanisms of Demographic Bias in LLMs for Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Applying mechanistic interpretability via activation patching in MLP layers and residual streams to alter implicit gender representations, and measuring resulting disparities in clinical vignette generation, depression risk assessment, and differential diagnosis ranking.

Using single-layer and sliding-window activation patching to intervene on internal representations of patient race, and evaluating how these interventions shift the distribution of generated patient demographics, depression risk predictions, and diagnostic accuracy across different racial groups (e.g., Black, White, Asian, Hispanic).
